description: This file is a shell script used to test the verbose output of git commands, specifically testing git operations over HTTP with verbose cURL output, involving setup of a git repository and checking error handling.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that may fail without failing the entire test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
